rationale: DevOps and cloud security teams at companies running AWS with CSPM tooling (PrismaCloud, Wiz, etc.) face continuous, recurring alert noise from necessary IAM admin access — this is a compliance audit headache that persists as long as the tooling is active. Willingness-to-pay is substantiated by confirmed spend on both AWS and PrismaCloud (neither cheap), plus documented competitor SaaS products (Sym, ConductorOne, Indent) charging $5–20k/year in this exact space. The primary constraint is operational autonomy: delivering meaningful remediation requires per-customer IAM context, limiting fully automated delivery.
